# HyperSage AI Labs

> HyperSage AI Labs is an independent studio that makes consumer apps and original
> games. Its apps cover crypto markets, relationships, health, recovery, food,
> stories, and sleep. Where an app uses AI, it has a specific job, such as
> explaining why a portfolio moved, adapting a recipe to what's in the kitchen, or
> preparing a brief for a doctor's visit. The studio designs, builds, and runs all
> of it in-house. Legal entity: HyperSage AI Labs LLC (Delaware, USA). Contact:
> support@hypersage.ai.

CryptoSage AI provides market information, not investment advice. Rowan, Quietoak and Alder support self-care and do not provide medical or mental-health treatment.

## Products

- [Holohound](https://hypersage.ai/holohound/): trading-card scanner and binder for Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Lorcana and Gundam; the prices it shows name their source, and an AI called Hound knows your binder (iOS, in development)
- [Wingmate](https://hypersage.ai/wingmate/): four AI dating coaches that remember the people you're talking to and turn a screenshot of your chat into suggested replies (iOS, live — [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6792772729))
- [Quietoak](https://hypersage.ai/quietoak/): self-help DBT skills app with an AI companion that remembers you, mood logging, a daily diary card, and an always-free crisis kit (iOS, coming soon)
- [Loam](https://hypersage.ai/loam/): AI notes companion that asks before it acts, tidies slips in place, and records every change it makes in a Ledger with undo and redo (iOS, coming soon)
- [CryptoSage AI](https://cryptosageai.io/): crypto portfolio tracker and market-research app; its AI knows what you hold, where you're exposed, and what moved your portfolio (iOS, live — [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6792761331))
- [Saffra](https://hypersage.ai/saffra/): AI recipe app whose recipes arrive complete, then adapt to your pantry, allergies, and time (iOS, live — [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6792760857))
- [StoryVault AI](https://hypersage.ai/storyvault/): branching interactive fiction written with AI; step into classics such as Beowulf and Dracula, or start your own world from a single line (iOS, live — [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6792759454))
- [Nightshelf](https://hypersage.ai/nightshelf/): bedtime-story app that reads complete classics aloud over ambient sound, with a sleep timer; Nightshelf Pro adds new AI-written stories (iOS, live — [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6792761643))
- [Hexhunter](https://hypersage.ai/hexhunter/): gothic horde-survivor game with nine heroes; pick a hero, draft upgrades as you level up, and survive three dark biomes (iOS, live — [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6792798732))
- [Mythwright](https://hypersage.ai/mythwright/): tactical card battler where the heroes and monsters of classic literature duel across three lanes (iOS, coming soon)
- [Rowan](https://hypersage.ai/rowan/): AI symptom tracker for chronic conditions; you describe your day in plain words and it becomes symptom logs and a visit brief for your doctor (iOS, live — [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6797693737))
- [Alder](https://hypersage.ai/alder/): private AI companion for sobriety and recovery that keeps your sober count, helps with cravings, and walks you through a slip without erasing what you've built (iOS, coming soon)
- [Waddleton](https://waddleton.pages.dev/): free-to-play snowy social world in the browser where you make a penguin, meet other players, and play 17 arcade games (live, [about](https://hypersage.ai/waddleton/))
- [Mythkin](https://hypersage.ai/mythkin/): AI character app for adults; talk to 470 figures from history, myth, literature and scripture, or write your own (iOS, coming soon)
- [Hoardling](https://hypersage.ai/hoardling/): hoard-defense game played from the dragon's side of the cave, where you hold the chokepoints and kill a carrier to send its coins home; free in the browser (live on the web, not on the App Store, [play](https://hypersage.ai/hoardling/play/))
- [Gemburrow](https://hypersage.ai/gemburrow/): cozy gem-digging puzzle where every gem and rock is real physics; free in the browser (live on the web, not on the App Store, [play](https://hypersage.ai/gemburrow/play/))
